name: Chiva
description: Chiva: Caribbean domino game (e.g. Puerto Rico). Four players in fixed partnerships; double-6 set. Play by matching ends; doubles crosswise. Team wins by scoring 4 or 6 times in a row (characteristic Caribbean style).

overview.description: Chiva: Caribbean domino game (e.g. Puerto Rico). Four players in fixed partnerships; double-6 set. Play by matching ends; doubles crosswise. Team wins by scoring 4 or 6 times in a row (characteristic Caribbean style).

history.origins: Caribbean (e.g. Jamaica, Puerto Rico). Partnership dominoes; objective to win several rounds in a row (e.g. 4 or 6). Double-6 set; holder of double-six poses first; play anticlockwise.
timeline: Chiva as local name for style

setup.players: 4; fixed partnerships, partners opposite. Play anticlockwise.
setup.dealing: Each player draws 7 bones. Holder of double-six poses first (or winner of previous hand); doubles played crosswise.

rules.objective: Win a set number of rounds in a row (e.g. 4 or 6) as a team. Opponent score resets your count.
rules.gameplay: Match touching ends; doubles at right angles. If you cannot play, pass. Round ends when a player empties hand or game is blocked. Winning team scores 1 (or 2 with key tiles); first team to target consecutive wins takes the game.
keyRules: Double-6; 7 tiles each; double-six poses first
Match ends; doubles crosswise; pass if no play
Win 4 or 6 rounds in a row to win game
